notes: ACCESS: potterybarnkids.co.uk runs NetSuite SuiteCommerce Advanced (COMPID 3572911, theme pk-uk-18-2), a different platform from the US Williams-Sonoma SPA siblings, so the Akamai/curl_cffi-iOS workaround was not needed. robots.txt names no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web rule (it contains only 'Disallow: /?'). Plain requests return HTTP 200 but every PLP is 100% client-rendered; requesting the same URLs with a Googlebot UA returns the site's SEO dynamic render (~118KB), as recorded in the prior Home-Decor pass. No proxy was needed. TREE: taken from the site's own category service https://www.potterybarnkids.co.uk/pk-uk-18-2/services/Categories.Service.ss?c=3572911&fullurl=<path>&n=34 , walked recursively from every top-level department (/baby /backpacks-study /bath /bed-linen /decor /furniture /kids-storage-organisation /play /rugs), and cross-checked against the category sitemap https://www.potterybarnkids.co.uk/SitemapFiles/PKUK/sitemap-1787061731817-PKUK-category-0.xml (247 URLs). Furniture lives entirely in the /furniture department, which has exactly four real product parents (Nursery Furniture, Bedroom Furniture, Study & Storage Furniture, Playroom Furniture) plus 'New & Featured' and 'Sale', both dropped per section 3. No furniture-typed node exists in Decor, Bath, Bed Linen or Rugs. The furniture leaves are cross-listed under /baby, /backpacks-study, /kids-storage-organisation and /play at identical totals (e.g. Bookcases = 11 at three different URL paths); I kept the canonical /furniture/... path for each and emitted no duplicate rows. QTY METHOD: the prerendered category HTML carries no visible 'N items' header (the SEO render omits the product grid), so counts come from the storefront's own same-origin PLP data call, /api/items?c=3572911&commercecategoryurl=<path>&fieldset=search&include=facets&... , which is embedded verbatim in each category page's rendered HTML - grepping the /furniture/kids-bedroom-furniture/kids-beds render found exactly one /api/items occurrence with those identical parameters. Its 'total' field is therefore the site's own count, not a third-party estimate. VALIDATION: (a) discrimination check - a bogus path (/furniture/this-does-not-exist-zzz) returns total=0 and department hub pages return total=0, while every leaf returns a different number, so it is not a site-wide constant; (b) full enumeration - paging offset 0..total at limit=50 and collecting unique 'internalid' values returned exactly the stated total on every leaf tested (kids-beds 23/23, cots 16/16, kids-desks 10/10), so the total is exact rather than inflated; (c) all 12 leaf totals were read twice in separate passes with identical results, no drift; (d) the h1 of the loaded page matches the category requested ('Beds' for kids-beds), so no silent parent-listing substitution. HIERARCHY: every 'All ...' node was tested for coverage rather than assumed. Set-differencing each 'All' node's item IDs against the union of its siblings showed all four are STRICT SUBSETS with zero items present only in the 'All' node (Nursery all=46 vs sibling union 52; Bedroom 58 vs 77; Study 28 vs 50; Playroom 24 vs 51). Dropping the shop-all nodes therefore loses no product and the leaves fully cover each department. EXCLUSIONS, all checked at product-title level rather than by name: 'Mattresses' (3) and 'Cot Mattresses' (1) - mattresses are bedding per the brief. 'Cot Conversion Kits' (/furniture/shop-nursery-furniture/toddler-bed-conversion-kit, total 9) - enumerated all 9: eight are 'Toddler Bed Conversion Kit Only' components that convert an existing cot, i.e. furniture parts, which the brief excludes; the ninth ('Elsie Toddler Bed') is a genuine bed, but rather than report a 9 that is 89% parts I dropped the category and flag it here as the one deliberate omission. 'Play Kitchens & Accessories' (30) - enumerated all 30: wooden toy food crates, tea sets, toy market stalls and toy coffee machines; primary product type is toys. 'All Playroom Furniture' (24) - a shop-all node and a strict subset of its siblings. Decor department nodes 'Shelving & Hooks' (28, decorative wall shelves and hook racks - Wall Decor's job), 'Bins & Baskets' (55, standalone storage goods), 'Pinboards', 'Lighting', 'Mirrors', 'Canopies & Hanging Decor', 'Cot Mobiles' and 'Jewellery Boxes' are all out of scope. In the 'Storage' department only Bookcases and Storage Wall Systems are furniture and both are already captured at their canonical /furniture paths. New & Featured / Bestsellers / New Arrivals / Sale / Clearance / Deals / buying guides all dropped per section 3. INCLUSION CALLS: 'Storage Wall Systems' (24) was title-checked before including - the items are Blake/Callum/Cameron/Parker modular cabinet, drawer-base, cubby and tower units and media sets, i.e. freestanding storage furniture, not storage baskets, so no ambiguous-shelving flag was needed. 'Nursery Chairs' (12) are all swivel gliders/recliners plus a glider-and-ottoman set. 'Outdoor Furniture' (5) are kids Adirondack chairs; kept under category 'Furniture' because the site itself files the node inside its Furniture department. 'Play Tables & Chairs' (17) are activity and play tables, play chairs and stools - kids furniture, explicitly in scope.
